description: Manages filesystem user defined extended attributes.

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description: If true, dereferences symlinks and sets/gets attributes on symlink target, otherwise acts on symlink itself. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The name of a specific Extended attribute key to set/retrieve.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace of the named name/key. Default: "user"

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The full path of the file/object to get the facts of.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Defines which state you want to do. read retrieves the current value for a key. present sets path to value, default if value is set. all dumps all data. keys retrieves all keys. absent deletes the key. Choices: "absent" "all" "keys" "present" "read" ← (default)

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set the named name/key to, it automatically sets the state to present.

examples:
- name: Obtain the extended attributes of /etc/foo.conf
  community.general.xattr:
    path: /etc/foo.conf

- name: Set the key 'user.foo' to value 'bar'
  community.general.xattr:
    path: /etc/foo.conf
    key: foo
    value: bar

- name: Set the key 'trusted.glusterfs.volume-id' to value '0x817b94343f164f199e5b573b4ea1f914'
  community.general.xattr:
    path: /mnt/bricks/brick1
    namespace: trusted
    key: glusterfs.volume-id
    value: "0x817b94343f164f199e5b573b4ea1f914"

- name: Remove the key 'user.foo'
  community.general.xattr:
    path: /etc/foo.conf
    key: foo
    state: absent

- name: Remove the key 'trusted.glusterfs.volume-id'
  community.general.xattr:
    path: /mnt/bricks/brick1
    namespace: trusted
    key: glusterfs.volume-id
    state: absent
